title: Velvety Vegan Thai Fish Curry Nam Prik
description: A creamy and floral Thai-inspired dish featuring apples and a mirepoix base, perfect for a sick day. This vegan version of nam prik is a twist on the traditional Thai fish curry.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large tagine pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, garlic, and red bell pepper, and sauté until the vegetables are tender.
Add the mushroom and cook until it releases its liquid and starts to brown.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the tomato paste and cook for another minute.
Add the coconut milk, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the apple and stir to coat with the curry sauce.
Simmer the curry for 10-15 minutes, until the flavors have melded together and the apple is tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
